observations.R15A: Hands move around the dough, with rolling/shaping and a later downward press that changes dough shape. Compared with the previously reviewed nearly static R13C example, this restores observable interaction and deformation while keeping the scene generally coherent.

limitations: Positive qualitative example, not an aggregate result. No claim that the physical module itself caused this improvement before comparing noC/nativeQuery/execution controls. Sampled frames do not establish all requested material properties.

additional_review_20261105.no_c: Hands knead/roll/press the dough with visible coherent deformation even with injection disabled. The normal clip's improvement over nearly static R13C cannot be attributed to the physical module alone.

review_scope: Eight sampled frames at fixed indices; diagnostic comparison, not exhaustive video assessment.
mean_C_review: MeanC retains coherent kneading and dough deformation in these frames; normal and noC also do. PC decreases by one point versus normal, showing that this selected view is not a complete explanation of the automated score.
